title: Intel ME explained (intel management engine) from insider
summary: A short video explaining the Intel Management Engine, a hidden embedded computer inside Intel machines with deep access to hardware. It is presented from an insider's perspective and raises backdoor and NSA concerns.
why: HN cites it as a quick introduction to why Intel ME is a trust problem for anyone worried about hardware-level access.

quote.text: This embedded computer system has access to all your memory devices.
